implementation.registration_order: Register immediately after app = FastAPI, before CORS and @app.middleware('http'); later Starlette middleware is outermost and BaseHTTPMiddleware otherwise re-emits ordinary JSON as streaming frames.

contract.eligible: HTTP 200, single-frame application/json, at least 4096 bytes, no existing content encoding, range, digest, ETag or Cache-Control:no-transform
contract.negotiation: gzip or wildcard with positive quality; an explicit gzip refusal wins, including across duplicate fields
contract.vary: Eligible identity and gzip representations both carry Vary: Accept-Encoding; existing Vary values and other headers are retained
contract.excluded: Streaming JSON, SSE, small JSON, non-JSON, pre-encoded, content-bound, trailer-declared, no-transform and non-200 responses
contract.timing: Known-ineligible starts such as SSE pass immediately, before the first event. JSON starts must wait for the first body frame to decide single-frame eligibility; streamed JSON first-frame latency is an inherent bounded limitation.
contract.unchanged: Routes, authentication, request body, cache-control policy, source data and model requests
contract.limitation: This reduces transfer size, not the number or duration of dictionary lookups or browser rendering after decompression.
